name: statz-nfl
description: Look up NFL statistics and Statz model projections: season leaders, player and team profiles, game-by-game team grids, standings, injuries, and projected scores for this week's games.

interface.longDescription:
Look up NFL statistics and Statz model projections in ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- See the season leaders for players (passing, rushing and receiving yards, touchdowns, tackles, sacks, interceptions and more) and for teams (points, yards, third-down rate, turnover differential and more).
- Check a player's season stats, recent games and injury status.
- Get a team's record, stat ranks, recent results and upcoming games.
- See every player's figure in one stat across a team's last 5 to 15 games, such as Patriots rushing yards game by game.
- See this week's games with the Statz model's projected score and win probability, and weekly player projections by position.
- Check injury reports and standings by division, conference or league.

Answers come with a ranked board and links to the full stats on statz.ai. Open Statz NFL from the sidebar to browse the boards.

Statz NFL provides statistics and projections only: no odds and no betting services.
capabilities: Season stat leaders for players and teams
Projected scores for this week's games
defaultPrompt: Who leads the NFL in rushing yards this season?
What are the projected scores for this week's NFL games?
Show every Patriots player's rushing yards game by game.

positive.description: Season leaders for one player stat.
positive.prompt: Who leads the NFL in rushing yards this season?
positive.expected_behavior: A board of the top 10 rushers with their teams and season rushing yards, highest first, and a link to the full leaderboard on statz.ai.

positive.description: This week's games with the Statz model's projections.
positive.prompt: What are Statz's projected scores for this week's NFL games?
positive.expected_behavior: A board of this week's games with kick-off time, the Statz projected score and each team's win probability. The reply says these are model projections.

positive.description: Weekly fantasy-point projections for one position.
positive.prompt: Which quarterbacks does Statz project to score the most fantasy points this week?
positive.expected_behavior: A board of up to 10 quarterbacks with their team, opponent and projected fantasy points, highest first.

positive.prompt: How is Patrick Mahomes doing this season, and is he injured?
positive.expected_behavior: Mahomes's season passing stats, his recent games and his current injury status, with a link to his page on statz.ai.

positive.description: Every player on a team, game by game, in one stat.
positive.prompt: Show every Patriots player's rushing yards over their last 10 games.
positive.expected_behavior: A grid with one row per Patriots player and one column per game (week, opponent, result), showing rushing yards and carries, each player's average, and a team total row.

negative.description: Asks for betting odds. Statz NFL carries no prices, bookmakers or betting links, so none should be returned. At most the model offers Statz's own statistics or projections and says they are not betting odds.
negative.prompt: What are the odds on the Chiefs winning the Super Bowl?

negative.description: Asks to place a bet. Every tool is read-only and none can place a bet or take any action.
negative.prompt: Put $20 on the Eagles to cover the spread this Sunday.

negative.description: Not an NFL statistics question, so no Statz NFL tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Kansas City tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: season stat leaders for players and teams, player and team profiles, game-by-game team grids, this week's games with projected scores, weekly player projections, injuries, standings and a sidebar app.
